newsitem.title: CHINA: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.60 percent.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day average accepted yield 5.60 percent.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.60 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 5.83 percent at the last tender and one-month HIBOR of 5.93229 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$14.48 billion against HK$9.19 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for 91-day Exchange Fund bills tendered on Tuesday was 5.58 percent compared with 5.78 percent at the last tender and three-month HIBOR of 6.07292 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$8.170 billion against HK$5.0 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for one-year Exchange Fund Notes tendered on Tuesday was 5.76 percent against 5.96 percent at the last auction and one-year HIBOR of 6.44271 percent.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue were HK$2.51 billion against HK$2.01 billion at the last tender.
